files.assembled_reading_copy: The thirty per-chapter PDFs from aa.org, concatenated in printed order: copyright, introduction, contents, foreword, Steps One to Twelve, Traditions One to Twelve, long form of the Traditions. 187 pages. Held outside the repository.

verified_pages.printed 132-138 (Tradition Two): rotating committee sharply limited in authority; servants not senators; elder statesmen and bleeding deacons; group conscience wiser than any single leader; Bill W deferring to the group over the Charlie proposal
verified_pages.printed 174-178 (Tradition Nine): no organization; dangers of entrenched power; long form states that rotating leadership is best
verified_pages.printed 187-191 (Tradition Twelve): anonymity as confidentiality and, separately, one hundred per cent anonymity at press, radio, film and television against self-appointed members presenting themselves as messiahs

cross_reference_test: No Tradition chapter cites the Step of its own number; the twelve Step chapters contain no occurrence of the word Tradition. The only indexed cross-reference in the book is Tradition Eight citing the Twelfth Step. Computed 10 August 2026 from the per-chapter PDFs; reproducible from the recorded hashes.
